meta.name: ai-automation-workflows
meta.description: Build automated AI workflows combining multiple models and services. Patterns: batch processing, scheduled tasks, event-driven pipelines, agent loops. Tools: inference.sh CLI, bash scripting, Python SDK, webhook integration. Use for: content automation, data processing, monitoring, scheduled generation. Triggers: ai automation, workflow automation, batch processing, ai pipeline, automated content, scheduled ai, ai cron, ai batch job, automated generation, ai workflow, content at scale, automation script, ai orchestration

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 模型调用编排成自动运行的流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想让 AI 任务按计划批量自动执行,不用每次手动跑
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate AI models into automated workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run AI tasks automatically on a schedule.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会使用 infsh 命令和 Bash/Python 脚本来编排多个模型应用,实现批处理、定时任务、条件分支、重试等自动化流程;它会运行脚本并把图片、文本等结果保存到文件或日志中。
howto.when: 当用户提到“ai automation”“batch processing”等触发词,或要求做内容自动化、数据处理、定时生成时触发。

say.text: 帮我写个脚本,把 data 文件夹里的每段文字都生成一张配图。
say.note: Claude 会调用 infsh 循环处理并保存结果。

say.text: 设置每天上午 9 点自动生成一篇带图的早安内容。
say.note: Claude 会给出 cron 定时脚本。

say.text: 做一个工作流:先搜索资料,再写文章,最后配图。
say.note: Claude 会按顺序串联多个模型。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the infsh CLI and Bash/Python scripts to orchestrate model apps: batch processing, scheduled tasks, conditional branches, retries. It runs scripts and saves outputs (images/text) to files or logs.
howto.when_en: Activated when the user mentions keywords like 'ai automation' or 'batch processing', or asks for content automation, data processing, scheduled generation, or monitoring.

say_en.text: Write a script to generate an image for each text in the data folder.
say_en.note: Claude will loop via infsh and save results.

say_en.text: Set up a daily 9 AM workflow that auto-generates a morning post with an image.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a cron script.

say_en.text: Build a pipeline that researches, writes an article, then creates an image.
say_en.note: Claude will chain multiple models sequentially.
